title: Intake: scope_in/scope_out overlap check — warn and re-prompt naming the conflicting item
description:
From the 2026-07-18 intake+KB-graph design review (Q1 Option 3). Nothing cross-checks scope_in vs scope_out; a normalized token can appear in both lists silently. Add an overlap check mirroring the existing per-question validate() hook pattern (precedent: the agent_models pair parser, src/question-library.js:118-129): when a normalized token appears in both scope_in and scope_out, warn naming the conflicting item(s) and re-prompt.

HUMAN SCOPE DECISION (2026-07-18): warn-but-allow posture (same as the empty-scope check) — the user may still proceed.
acceptance_criteria: When a normalized token (case- and whitespace-insensitive) appears in both scope_in and scope_out, the wizard warns naming the conflicting item(s) and re-prompts; the user may still proceed (warn-but-allow).
Disjoint lists pass silently (no false warnings); empty lists pass silently.
Token normalization matches the existing comma-split/trim conventions (src/question-library.js) — proven by fixtures including case and whitespace variants.
tdd: parsing/validation logic + fixtures; existing wizard specs stay green.
